rows.text: The party's page on the Diet members' vote captions, on ９月２１日, the election administration committee chair 谷川 declaring the Diet-member vote open at 16:00, the candidates 小渕, 加藤 and 山崎 voting, the count beginning at 16:45 and 谷川 announcing the result of the vote at 17:00.
